data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reported a significant gross prior year reserve release of GBP 1,271.2 million, primarily driven by the impact of the 2023 RiverStone contracts. These contracts involved a split reinsurance to close for the 2018 and prior years of account, transferring financial benefits/liabilities, and a quota share arrangement for discontinued lines written in 2019 and subsequent years. This transaction significantly reduced the syndicate's historic liabilities. Additionally, the syndicate noted a net reduction in prior period reserves of GBP 25.3 million due to a comparatively benign catastrophe loss year in 2023 and improved current accident year non-cat performance, alongside changes in reinsurance arrangements including a reduction in the WAQS cession and outwards reinsurance programme cost savings.
